query.description: The April 15, 2025 Council packet carries the March 4 minutes. Its physical page 8 records the FAB FY25/26–26/27 workplan as Received and Filed.

query.sql: WITH timeline(event_date, event, evidence, source_ref) AS (VALUES ('2025-01-28', 'FAB adopted the FY 2025/2026–2026/2027 Workplan', 'Motion by Farhad, second by Vice Chair Carvel; four ayes and no noes', 'Filed workplan p. 17; P01 p. 19'), ('2025-03-04', 'City Council received and filed the FAB workplan', 'Council minutes record the workplan as Received and Filed', 'Council minutes p. 8'), ('2026-07-28', 'FY25-26 accomplishments and FY26-27 workplan item was scheduled', 'Meeting cancelled on July 27; no action can be inferred', 'C01'), ('2026-08-25', 'Accomplishments and workplan item was re-agendized', 'Agenda only in the local archive; no packet or minutes available', 'C02')) SELECT event_date, event, evidence, source_ref FROM timeline ORDER BY event_date;
filters: Only formally adopted, filed, cancelled, or agenda-only plan events are shown
The August 25 agenda is not treated as proof of a newer plan or action

query.description: Compact objective frame transcribed from the adopted workplan. The motion signal is an analytical summary, not an official completion finding.

query.description: Counts of the 17 affirmative non-routine actions, classified once by their primary workplan relationship. Direct and related actions are both included; the count is not a completion score.
query.sql: WITH objective_counts(objective_id, objective_short, affirmative_action_count) AS (VALUES ('W1', 'Budget-development cycle', 1), ('W2', 'Mid-year adjustments', 0), ('W3', 'Service delivery and staffing', 2), ('W4', 'Long-term plan and reserves', 9), ('W5', 'UAL', 0), ('W6', 'Quarterly budget updates', 0), ('W7', 'Section 115', 1), ('W8', 'Purchasing policy', 1), ('W9', 'Comprehensive Financial Policy', 2), ('W10', 'Investment and capital policy', 1)) SELECT objective_id, objective_short, affirmative_action_count FROM objective_counts ORDER BY objective_id;

metric_definitions: affirmative_action_count = number of included affirmative recorded actions; it is not a measure of implementation, importance, or staff work

blocks.body: # El Cerrito FAB Workplan-Rooted Motion Summary

## Technical summary

The last **formally adopted and City Council-filed** Financial Advisory Board (FAB) plan evidenced in the local official archive is the **FY 2025/2026–2026/2027 Workplan**. FAB adopted it on **January 28, 2025**; City Council recorded it **Received and Filed** on **March 4, 2025**. The substantive motion search therefore begins at that adoption, not at a one-year cutoff or a presumed July filing date.

From January 28, 2025 through the latest available FAB minutes, June 4, 2026, the workplan-rooted ledger captures **23 non-routine recorded outcomes**: **17 substantive affirmative actions**, **4 failed for lack of a second**, **1 with no stated disposition**, and **1 procedural deferral**. Of the 17 substantive affirmative outcomes, **6 are direct matches** to a named objective and **11 are related or partial matches**. The recovered November 13, 2025 minutes are recorded separately below because their procedural tabling, routine calendar action, and failed demolition recommendation do not change those scoped counts. This is a source-backed action ledger—not proof that City Council adopted, funded, or implemented any recommendation.

## Filing and timing

The workplan itself uses milestones such as Q2, Q1 2026, Q3, and quarterly; it does **not** set a July accomplishments deadline. The City Council agenda bill instead states the citywide procedure: advisory bodies are to adopt and post their workplan by July 1 of applicable years, and update/post annual accomplishments by July 1. That is a deadline, not proof that this FAB plan was filed in July.

A July 28, 2026 agenda item for FY25-26 accomplishments and a FY26-27 workplan was cancelled, then re-agendized for August 25. The local archive has only the August agenda, so it cannot establish a newer adopted or filed workplan.

## Workplan objective frame

The table anchors the review in the adopted plan rather than in generic financial topics. A motion can map to more than one goal; for counting and readability, the ledger assigns one **primary** relationship and explains related cases conservatively. No recorded motion against an objective does not mean the Board did no work on it.

## Where affirmative actions clustered

The chart includes every affirmative non-routine action once, using its primary workplan objective. It is not a progress or importance ranking. In particular, the apparent concentration in long-term planning and reserves includes related ISF, KPI, and spending actions—not evidence that the full five-year-plan deliverable was completed.

## ACFR and budget findings

- **ACFR:** On January 27, 2026, FAB unanimously passed a Council recommendation following its FY24-25 ACFR review, asking particular attention to controlling and reducing expenses. ACFR is not a named workplan objective, so this is classified as **related** to the long-term financial-plan/expenditure objective.
- **Early budget actions:** On April 29, 2025 FAB approved a 2 percent General Fund set-aside for one-time expenditures (3-1). On May 27 it approved asking Council to agendize FAB guidance on future one-time expenditures (4-1). Both are related budget/long-range actions, not the plan's specific goal to extend budget-development revision cycles.
- **Reserve and ISF actions:** On October 28 FAB unanimously recommended meeting the 17 percent unassigned-reserve goal. On May 7, 2026 the 30 percent and 28 percent proposals failed for lack of a second; the 26 percent reserve-plus-ISF proposal received a 3-2 affirmative vote, and the 890,000-dollar Scenario C/D ISF recommendation was 5-0.
- **May 26 budget actions:** FAB affirmed ISF planning (4-1), a December 2026 ISF policy (5-0), a fiscal-sustainability KPI framework (3-2), and maintaining the expanded CIP (4-1). The proposed two-year budget recommendation failed for lack of a second.
- **Service delivery:** FAB asked to evaluate and advise on Service Delivery Study recommendations before Council action (5-0), then approved a service-level-agreement recommendation on June 4 (4-0). These actions are related to, but do not themselves make the plan's stated staffing-level recommendation from study results.

Each statement is a FAB outcome. None establishes subsequent Council action or implementation.

## Workplan-rooted non-routine motion ledger

`Direct` means the motion immediately addresses a named plan objective. `Related / partial` means the subject overlaps the plan but does not carry out its stated deliverable. The January 27 long-term-forecast entry is kept as a procedural deferral because it explains why no substantive recommendation was made then. The separately displayed November 13 tabling action has the same procedural treatment.

The baseline January 28 minutes also record **no action** on purchasing-ordinance recommendations and budget-cycle revision recommendations. Those are important objective-level facts, but they are not counted as motions. Routine minute approvals and board officer elections or appointments are excluded from this ledger.

## Recovered November 13 minutes: outcomes and scope treatment

The December 18, 2025 FAB packet resolves the earlier missing-minutes gap. The Comprehensive Financial Policy tabling is a passed procedural deferral and is not included in the 17 substantive affirmative actions. The calendar adoption is routine. The Church-property demolition recommendation failed; its workplan relationship is not assumed, so it is retained here without an objective mapping.

## Methodology and scope

I reviewed the canonical local FAB agenda-packet archive from the January 28, 2025 workplan adoption through the June 4, 2026 minutes, and checked the July 28 cancellation and August 25 agenda-only records for later plan evidence. Minutes are often attached to a later agenda packet; each row therefore cites the packet and physical PDF page where the completed-meeting record appears.

A vote-only affirmative result is described as a recorded affirmative vote rather than as an explicit passage where the minutes do not say `Motion passed`. Agenda proposals and discussions without a motion are not converted into action. This report distinguishes a motion's passage from later Council implementation.

## Limits and source-quality flags

- The held **November 13, 2025** minutes are present in the December 18, 2025 FAB agenda packet (ArchiveCenter item 8128, physical PDF pp. 1-3). The recovered outcomes and their scope treatment appear below.
- The current plan's cover contains the source-authored sentence `This document is superceded by the FY25-27 document`, despite itself being titled FY 2025/2026–2026/2027. The verified adoption and filing support its use as the latest confirmed frame; the sentence alone does not prove a newer plan.
- The July 22, 2025 accomplishments discussion has no recorded motion. The August 26 accomplishments vote removed a claimed budget-cycle recommendation and added `No recommendation made`; it is not evidence that a budget-cycle revision recommendation passed.
- The May 7 completed-meeting record has an incorrect April 28 footer, although its roll call and internal record identify the May 7 meeting.
- The August 25, 2026 FAB agenda is not yet a minutes record. The official FAB workplan archive still lists only the 2025/2026–2026/2027 plan, so a current proposed workplan is unavailable for a completed no-double-counting crosswalk.

## Official source map

- [Filed FAB workplan, ArchiveCenter item 7932](https://www.elcerrito.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/7932): adopted-plan internal pp. 1-17; adoption vote on p. 17.
- [March 4 Council agenda packet, file 2304](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2304,plainText=false%29): agenda bill pp. 25-26 describes the receive-and-file action and July 1 procedure; plan attachment pp. 27-43.
- [Council minutes packet, file 2357](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2357,plainText=false%29): March 4 minutes, physical p. 8, record the FAB workplan as Received and Filed.
- [P01 — February 25, 2025 FAB packet, file 2768](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2768,plainText=false%29): January 28 minutes, physical p. 19.
- [P02 — April 29, 2025 FAB packet, file 2764](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2764,plainText=false%29): March 25 minutes, physical pp. 19-21.
- [P03 — May 27, 2025 FAB packet, file 2766](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2766,plainText=false%29): April 29 minutes, physical pp. 1-2.
- [P04 — June 24, 2025 FAB packet, file 2763](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2763,plainText=false%29): May 27 minutes, physical pp. 1-2.
- [P05 — July 22, 2025 FAB packet, file 2762](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2762,plainText=false%29): June 24 minutes, physical pp. 1-2.
- [P06 — September 23, 2025 FAB packet, file 2760](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2760,plainText=false%29): August 26 minutes, physical pp. 1-3.
- [P07 — October 28, 2025 FAB packet, file 2759](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2759,plainText=false%29): September 23 minutes, physical pp. 1-2.
- [P08 — November 13, 2025 FAB packet, file 2757](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=2757,plainText=false%29): October 28 minutes, physical pp. 1-3.
- [P09 — January 27, 2026 FAB packet, file 3177](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3177,plainText=false%29): December 18 minutes, physical pp. 1-3.
- [P10 — February 12, 2026 FAB packet, file 3175](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3175,plainText=false%29): January 27 minutes, physical pp. 14-15.
- [P11 — May 26, 2026 FAB packet, file 3350](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3350,plainText=false%29): May 7 minutes, physical pp. 4-5.
- [P12 — June 4, 2026 FAB packet, file 3400](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3400,plainText=false%29): May 26 minutes, physical pp. 4-5.
- [P13 — July 28, 2026 cancellation packet, file 3499](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3499,plainText=false%29): June 4 minutes, physical pp. 3-4.
- [C01 — July 28, 2026 cancellation agenda, file 3500](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3500,plainText=false%29): cancelled accomplishment/workplan item.
- [C02 — August 25, 2026 agenda, file 3694](https://elcerritoca.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream%28fileId=3694,plainText=false%29): re-agendized accomplishment/workplan item; agenda only.
- [P14 — December 18, 2025 FAB packet, ArchiveCenter item 8128](https://www.elcerrito.gov/ArchiveCenter/ViewFile/Item/8128): November 13 minutes, physical pp. 1-3.
